The dish is a square plate of about 24 cm. The food on it is a small pile of fresh spinach leaves with a few shreds of carrot, covering roughly 10 by 12 cm. Fresh spinach in a loose pile like this weighs about 40-50 g. The carrot and any light dressing add a few more grams, so I estimate about 50 g in total. Spinach has roughly 23 kcal per 100 g, which gives about 12 kcal. I'll allow some extra for a light dressing or oil, which brings the estimate to about 25 kcal.
